patthana17.19:1.1: Kusalo ajjhatto dhammo naajjhattassa nakusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (Saṃkhittaṃ.)… Ārammaṇe aṭṭhārasa.
patthana17.19:2.1: Kusalo bahiddhā dhammo nabahiddhā nakusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (Saṃkhittaṃ.)… Ārammaṇe aṭṭhārasa.
patthana17.19:3.1: Kusalaṃ ajjhattārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nakusalo naajjhattārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā nava.
patthana17.19:4.1: Kusalaṃ bahiddhārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nakusalo nabahiddhārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā nava.
